title: Texas Sugar Daddies Menu
subtitle: Sweet Treats + Catering – From breakfast boxes to buffet service, we've got your Texas-sized appetite covered

items.name: Breakfast Box
items.description: Packaged individually with 3oz of each item: Scrambled Eggs, Refried Beans, Breakfast Potatoes with Two Tortillas. Choice of Bacon, Ham, or Country Sausage.

items.name: Yogurt + Fruit Breakfast Box
items.description: Packaged individually with Vanilla Yogurt, Granola, Seasonal Fresh Fruit, and a Boiled Egg.

items.name: Pastry Box
items.description: Chef's Choice Variety – 2 per person and Seasonal Fresh Fruit. Includes Mini Plates, Serving Tongs, and Napkins.

items.name: Breakfast Taco Box - Individually Wrapped
items.description: Bacon and Egg: $2.75 | Sausage and Egg: $2.75 | Bean and Cheese: $2.50 | Potato and Egg: $2.50

items.name: Casserole Buffet Breakfast with Service
items.description: Egg, Cheese and Veggie Casserole with choice of Bacon, Ham, or County Sausage. Includes Breakfast Potatoes, Seasonal Fruit Mix, Variety of Mini Pastries, Orange Juice, Coffee, Water and Ice.

items.name: Fiesta Breakfast Buffet with Service
items.description: Scrambled Egg Mixed with choice of Bacon, Ham, or County Sausage. Includes Potatoes a La Mexicana, Refried Beans and Chorizo, Two Tortillas, Variety of Mini Pastries, Orange Juice, Coffee, Water and Ice.

items.name: Hot Oatmeal Bar with Service
items.description: Freshly Prepared Oatmeal with Ultimate Toppings: Chocolate Chips, Seasonal Fruit, Brown Sugar, Syrup, Granola, Nuts, Cinnamon, Honey. Includes Variety of Mini Pastries, Orange Juice, Coffee, Water and Ice.

items.name: Texas Fiesta Taco Plate
items.description: A flavor explosion with your choice of seasoned ground beef, marinated grilled chicken or pork asada served with 3 mini tortillas fresh salsa, spanish rice and charro beans. Comes with Chef Choice Pastry Tray.

items.name: David's BBQ Shredded Beef on a Bun
items.description: Slow cooked, smokey Texas-style shredded beef, paired with our house made BBQ sauce served on a flour tortilla (comes with 2) and a side of potato salad, onions and pickles. Comes with Chef Choice Pastry Tray.

items.name: Chris' Texas Roasted Chicken
items.description: Oven roasted seasoned leg quarter chicken accompanied by seasonal flavored vegetables and garlic butter mashed potatoes. Comes with Chef Choice Pastry Tray.

items.name: Arroz con Pollo
items.description: Tender chicken pieces simmered in a savory blend of tomatoes, onions, garlic and spices, served on a bed of Spanish rice. Accompanied with charro beans. Comes with Chef Choice Pastry Tray.

items.name: Fideo Loco
items.description: So many good flavors...it's crazy! Ground beef, potatoes, beans and fideo in a delicious broth served with 2 flour tortillas. Comes with Chef Choice Pastry Tray.

items.name: Boxed Lunches
items.description: Includes Napkins and Utensils if needed. Delivery Fee: $10 inside Loop 410 and $20 outside Loop 410.

items.name: The Texas Club
items.description: Sliced turkey breast, ham, smoked bacon and American cheese with all the sandwich fixin's (lettuce, tomatoes) between bread. Served with Assorted Chips, a Pickle Spear and a Texas Sugar Daddies Cookie of the Day.

items.name: Italian Grilled Sandwich
items.description: Ham, salami, cheese with lettuce, tomato and Italian vinaigrette between bread. Served with Assorted Chips, a Pickle Spear and a Texas Sugar Daddies Cookie of the Day.

items.name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
items.description: Shredded chicken, with lettuce, tomato and TSD touch of seasonings between bread. Served with Assorted Chips, a Pickle Spear and a Texas Sugar Daddies Cookie of the Day.

items.name: Pizza Quesadilla
items.description: 3 pieces made with mozzarella cheese and pepperoni and a side of house made marinara sauce. Served with Assorted Chips, a Pickle Spear and a Texas Sugar Daddies Cookie of the Day.

items.name: Texas Caesar Bacon Salad
items.description: Grilled Chicken slices, bacon with romaine lettuce, tomatoes parmesan cheese and our house-made Caesar dressing. Served with a Texas Sugar Daddies Cookie of the Day.

items.name: Desserts
items.description: Texan Banana Pudding, Mexican Chocolate Pudding, Sweet Potato Pie Pudding.

items.name: Standard Cupcakes
items.description: Mexican Chocolate, Strawberry, and Mexican Vanilla flavors.

items.name: Specialty Cupcakes
items.description: Mangonada, Oreo, Hawaiian, Texican Chocolate, Cascarone, Concha, Fressanada, Atole de Arroz, and other customized options.

items.name: Mini Cupcakes
items.description: One dozen mini cupcakes in various flavors.

items.name: Cakes
items.description: Smash Cake (5" round): $35 | Round Cake (10" round): $50 | 1/4 Sheet: $45 | 1/2 Sheet: $75 | 10" Bundt: $45 | Mini Bundles: $36 per dozen. All with custom designs.

items.name: Cookies by Baker's Dozen (13)
items.description: TSD Signature Wedding Cookies, Texas Shaped Pan de Polvo, Decorated Sugar Cookies, Peanut Butter, Chocolate Crinkle, Lemon Crinkle, Peanut Butter Temptation. Wide variety of flavors available.

items.name: Decorated Sugar Cookies
items.description: Printed and decorated sugar cookies. Price varies by size and design.

items.name: Other Sweet Options
items.description: Cake Pops: $25/cz | Lollipops: $25/ctz | Candied Pecans: $15/lb (Texas Pecans coated in sugar and cinnamon). Wide variety of flavors available.

items.name: Pies
items.description: Pecan, Pumpkin, Sweet Potato, Chocolate Silk, Coconut Creme, Banana Pudding, Buttermilk, Lemon Meringue, Cherry, Apple, and many other flavors. 9" Deep Dish: $25 starting | Mini Pies: $30/dz

items.name: Brisket Buffet
items.description: BBQ Brisket, Sausage, Potato Salad, Rice, Beans, Pickle Slices, Onion, BBQ Sauce, Jalapenos and Sliced Bread.

items.name: BBQ Chicken Buffet
items.description: Chicken Leg Quarters and Sausage, Rice, Beans, Pickle Slices, Onion, BBQ Sauce, Jalapenos and Sliced Bread.

items.name: Mini Taco Bar
items.description: 3 Mini Tacos of Diced Chicken Fajita, Al Pastor and Carne Asada. Sides include Rice, Charro Beans, Cilantro, Onions, Salsa, Limes and Sour Cream.

items.name: Pasta Bar
items.description: Serving of Pasta, Marinara Sauce, Alfredo Sauce, Seasoned Ground Meat, Diced Chicken, Garlic Bread and Salad Bar.

items.name: Baked Chicken Buffet
items.description: Leg Quarter with Garlic Mashed Potatoes, Steamed Veggie, and Salad Bar.

items.name: Discada Buffet
items.description: Saucy Meat Mixed Variety, Tortillas, Salsa, Rice and Beans.

items.name: Fideo Loco Buffet
items.description: Fideo with Ground Meat, a side of Charro Beans, and 2 Flour Tortillas.

items.name: Buffet Service Includes
items.description: One Hour Buffet and Beverage Service includes: Iced Tea, Lemonade, Cups, Plates, Napkins, Utensils. We also offer Bakery Items including Cake, Cookies, and other Assorted Desserts at additional cost.
